mapper.select: SELECT b.user_id, b.task_id, t.input_json, t.status AS task_status, (t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested, c.generation AS conversation_generation, c.status AS conversation_status FROM sq_runtime_binding b JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = b.user_id AND t.task_id = b.task_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.conversation_id = t.conversation_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.role = 'MASTER' AND c.active_task_id = t.task_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT snapshot_id, user_id, task_id, target_node_key, logical_key, conversation_generation, memory_revision, items_json, token_estimate, content_hash, goal_revision FROM sq_context_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND target_node_key = #{targetNodeKey} AND logical_key = #{logicalKey} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT snapshot_id, user_id, task_id, target_node_key, logical_key, conversation_generation, memory_revision, items_json, token_estimate, content_hash, goal_revision FROM sq_context_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_context_snapshot (snapshot_id, user_id, task_id, target_node_key, logical_key, conversation_generation, memory_revision, items_json, token_estimate, content_hash, goal_revision, scope_id, creator_id, creator_name, last_updater_id, last_updater_name) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{targetNodeKey}, #{logicalKey}, #{conversationGeneration}, #{memoryRevision}, #{itemsJson}, #{tokenEstimate}, #{contentHash}, #{goalRevision}, (SELECT scope_id FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}), #{userId}, '', #{userId}, '')
